goal: Reduce debris occupying the declared target region below the scenario threshold, then confirm the region is clear
evidence_policy: A pre-clean occupancy observation, a post-clean occupancy observation, and an ActionResult referencing both are required before verification runs.
non_goals: does not claim a cleaning endpoint that exists in this repository
does not define brush speed, suction power or any other actuator parameter
does not claim Gazebo or physical validation
